text: I Give thanks to the Lord, invoke his name; [AA]make known among the peoples his deeds! [AB]
Sing praise to him, play music;proclaim all his wondrous deeds!
Glory in his holy name;let hearts that seek the Lord rejoice!
Seek out the Lord and his might;constantly seek his face. [AC]
Recall the wondrous deeds he has done,his wonders and words of judgment,
You descendants of Abraham his servant,offspring of Jacob the chosen one!
II He the Lord, is our Godwhose judgments reach through all the earth.
He remembers forever his covenant,the word he commanded for a thousand generations,
Which he made with Abraham,and swore to Isaac, [AD]
And ratified in a statute for Jacob,an everlasting covenant for Israel:
"To you I give the land of Canaan,your own allotted inheritance." [AE]
III When they were few in number, [AF]a handful, and strangers there,
Wandering from nation to nation,from one kingdom to another people,
He let no one oppress them;for their sake he rebuked kings: [1]
t[2]"Do not touch my anointed ones,to my prophets do no harm."
IV Then he called down a famine on the land,destroyed the grain that sustained them. [3] [AG]
He had sent a man ahead of them,Joseph, sold as a slave. [AH]
They shackled his feet with chains;collared his neck in iron, [AI]
Till his prediction came to pass,and the word of the Lord proved him true. [AJ]
The king sent and released him;the ruler of peoples set him free. [AK]
He made him lord over his household,ruler over all his possessions, [AL]
To instruct his princes as he desired,to teach his elders wisdom.
V Then Israel entered Egypt; [AM]Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham. [4]
God greatly increased his people,made them more numerous than their foes. [AN]
He turned their hearts to hate his people,to treat his servants deceitfully. [AO]
He sent his servant Moses,and Aaron whom he had chosen. [AP]
t[5]They worked his signs in Egypt [AQ]and wonders in the land of Ham.
He sent darkness and it grew dark,but they rebelled against his word.
He turned their waters into bloodand killed their fish.
Their land swarmed with frogs,even the chambers of their kings.
He spoke and there came swarms of flies,gnats through all their country.
For rain he gave them hail,flashes of lightning throughout their land.
He struck down their vines and fig trees,shattered the trees of their country.
He spoke and the locusts came,grasshoppers without number. [AR]
They devoured every plant in the land;they devoured the crops of their fields.
He struck down every firstborn in the land,the first fruits of all their vigor.
He brought his people out,laden with silver and gold; [AS]no one among the tribes stumbled.
Egypt rejoiced when they left,for fear had seized them.
VI He spread a cloud out as a cover,and made a fire to light up the night. [AT]
They asked and he brought them quail;with bread from heaven he filled them. [AU]
He split the rock and water gushed forth;it flowed through the desert like a river. [AV]
For he remembered his sacred promiseto Abraham his servant.
He brought his people out with joy,his chosen ones with shouts of triumph.
He gave them the lands of the nations,they took possession of the wealth of the peoples, [AW]
That they might keep his statutesand observe his teachings. [AX]Hallelujah!
